about.title: How this is made
about.intro: Every edition of Tabayyun is compiled by an AI editor from the sources listed below and published without waiting for a person to review it; each story says whether an editor has reviewed it yet. Nothing is written that is not in a source, and every claim links to where it came from.
about.verseGist: In brief: if a news-bearer brings you a report, verify it.
about.nameText: Tabayyun (<ur>تبیُّن</ur>) means looking into a report until what is true is clear. The word is this verse's instruction, fa-tabayyanū: verify it. Every edition is made that way: each story is traced to the outlets that carried it, and where they disagree, the story says so.
about.correctionsText: Published editions are never edited in place. Corrections are added below the story with the date.

images.policyText: Photos on stories belong to the outlets credited under them. A story shows a photo only from an article it cites, at a small size and with a link to the original. No image is made by AI, and an image's description is the publisher's own, never written by AI. Images that may be distressing stay blurred until you choose to see them. You can turn images off under Display.
